$comment: Product metadata for listing and catalogue use. Not read by the engine.

positioning.one_line: For managers whose problem is not running meetings but closing what comes out of them: a daily and weekly meeting cadence, a RACI chart, a deadline tracker, and a weekly review that counts actions closed rather than meetings held.

primary: Anyone chairing recurring meetings that produce commitments

differentiators: Daily Meeting Planner — the day's meetings, prep, and the one you could decline
Responsibility Assignment chart — responsible, accountable, consulted, informed
Deadline Tracker with a Chase On column ahead of the due date
Team Meeting Log that opens with last week's actions, closed or not
Meeting Objectives page completed before the invitation goes out
Weekly Review measured in actions closed, not meetings held
Progress Dashboard — thirteen weeks of meetings, hours, opened, closed, overdue
Four sizes, verified page and link parity

differs_from.004-meeting-planner: SEVERE OVERLAP — SAME CATEGORY. 05 is a template library organised by meeting type: board, workshop, training, video call, communication log, recurring-meeting audit, room and tool register. This product is organised around follow-through: daily cadence, RACI, deadlines, chases, and a review that counts closure. 05 is broader by meeting type; this is deeper on accountability. Both must not be listed with similar titles or first lines.

catalogue_warning: This product was built on explicit instruction after the overlap with products/05-meeting-planner was flagged. Before listing, decide one of: (a) retitle both and differentiate the first two lines of each description, (b) delist 05 and treat this as its replacement, or (c) merge the two into a single larger product. Listing both as-is will split search traffic and invite duplicate-purchase complaints.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
